# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

[ Explore insights ][93]

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

# The Pill that
# moves the needle^{®}

## About Vaxart

Vaxart is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a range of oral recombinant pill
vaccines based on our innovative delivery platform.

We have proprietary technology, partnerships to accelerate our development, and an experienced team
with deep industry expertise.

## Our Mission

From the beginning, Vaxart has been on a mission to transform global health by pioneering oral pill
vaccines that provide both mucosal and systemic immunity against common viral diseases.

We are dedicated to advancing vaccine science to create safe, effective, and accessible solutions
that protect communities worldwide and empower people to lead healthier lives.

[Learn About Us][23]

## Our Science

Vaxart’s oral pill vaccines are designed to generate durable mucosal and systemic immunity, offering
a potentially revolutionary advance in immunization technology.

# The Pill that
# moves the needle^{®}

## About Vaxart

Vaxart is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a range of oral recombinant pill
vaccines based on our innovative delivery platform.

We have proprietary technology, partnerships to accelerate our development, and an experienced team
with deep industry expertise.

## Our Mission

From the beginning, Vaxart has been on a mission to transform global health by pioneering oral pill
vaccines that provide both mucosal and systemic immunity against common viral diseases.

We are dedicated to advancing vaccine science to create safe, effective, and accessible solutions
that protect communities worldwide and empower people to lead healthier lives.

[Learn About Us][23]
Close

## Our Science

Vaxart’s oral pill vaccines are designed to generate durable mucosal and systemic immunity, offering
a potentially revolutionary advance in immunization technology.

[Learn About Our Science][24]

# Home Biose

# Your microbiome partner
# for health and well-being
# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

# Advanced Cleaning Solutions

Borer Chemie AG ist ein weltweit tätiger Hersteller von Produkten für die anspruchsvolle Reinigung
im Industriebereich, der Spitalhygiene, im Labor- und Pharmasektor sowie in der Hände- und
Flächendesinfektion.

Bei unseren Kunden schaffen wir Mehrwert durch effiziente Reinigungs- und Desinfektionsprozesse und
unterstützen sie damit in ihrer täglichen Arbeit. Die Produkte unserer Marken deconex® und decosept®
stellen wir seit über 60 Jahren an unserem Hauptsitz in der Schweiz her. Mit unseren
Tochtergesellschaften in Deutschland und China sowie unserem Netz an Vertriebspartnern gewährleisten
wir die weltweite Verfügbarkeit unseres breiten Portfolios an erprobten Markenprodukten.

Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Märkte und der sich laufend verschärfenden Gesetzgebungen, entwickelt

rückstandsfreien Oberflächen, die Beurteilung ökologischer Aspekte sowie die Beratung unserer Kunden
und Anwender zum wirtschaftlichsten Einsatz unserer Produkte.

## in zweiter Generation

Was 1965 mit einer Vision und der Gründung der «PMC Produkte für Medizin und Chemie» begann, ist
heute ein global agierendes Familienunternehmen. Unser Hauptsitz liegt zwar im ländlichen Zuchwil,
unsere Markenprodukte deconex® und decosept® sind jedoch weltweit erfolgreich im Einsatz. Wir haben
uns in über 50 Jahren ein umfassendes Wissen in den verschiedensten Bereichen der anspruchsvollen
Reinigung und Desinfektion aufgebaut. Als Spezialisten leisten wir in den Branchen, in denen wir
tätig sind, einen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Reinigungs- und Desinfektionsprozesse unserer
Kunden.

absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

precision cancer treatment.

native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

As a trusted E. coli CDMO partner, we support clients across the full development lifecycle—from
early R&D and strain engineering to cGMP microbial fermentation, downstream purification, and
analytical testing. Our facilities adhere to the highest standards of regulatory compliance and
quality assurance, making us a reliable manufacturing partner for biotechs developing clinical or
commercial-stage products.

At Elise, our mission is to empower innovation through collaborative, science-first partnerships.
Whether you’re developing recombinant proteins, alternative proteins, or engineered biologics, we
tailor our microbial fermentation services to fit your exact specifications and speed your
time-to-market. With a passion for precision and a commitment to progress, Elise Biopharma is proud
to enable the next wave of biomanufacturing breakthroughs—improving health outcomes and driving
impact across healthcare, diagnostics, and industrial biotechnology.

# Science in Society Archive

The Science in Society website is an archive of scientific reports, journalism and audio visual
material representing two decades of work by the [Institute of Science in Society][7], the
Independent Science Panel, I-SISart and theSparc. There are close to 2000 reports available on this
site: some are previously published in print, others only electronically. The majority are available
for the first time with extra illustrations and references; this site represents a body of work
available nowhere else online or in print. Please search for documents by [category][8], use the
[search function][9], or see a list of all documents in the [sitemap][10]. Hard copies of major
reports are available [here][11], with CD-roms and DVDs available [here][12].

[I-SIS major reports]

### Major Reports

the Institute of Science in Society and the Independent Science Panel produced a number of
significant reports on the topics of Energy policy, Sustainability, Biotechnology, and the
Environment. These are all available in print form and electronically. [Banishing Glyphosate][13] |
[Ban GMOs Now][14] | [Death Camp Fukushima Chernobyl][15] | [The Case for A GM-Free Sustainable
World][16] | [Which Energy?][17] | [Food Futures Now][18] | [Green Energies][19]

[Science in Society Magazine]

### Science in Society Magazine

The influential in-house magazine of the Institute of Science in Society - "The only radical science
magazine on earth". Science in Society (formerly I-SIS News) was published between 1999 and 2016,
and was widely circulated to the public, politicians and policy makers worldwide. Reports from all
69 issues are available on this site - please examine the [SiS index][20] to see the contents of
each issue. Back issues and electronic copies are still available in the SiS online store.

[I-SIS events]

### Events

Aswell as producing scientific reports, the forementioned organisations hosted several high profile
events, including in the British and European Parliaments. These were predominantly scientific, but
also throwing art and music into the mix.

Highlights include the [Colours of Water][21] (2013), [Quantum Jazz - Biology* Medicine* Art][22]
(2011), Green Energies Launch (2009), GM Free Europe (2007), Which Energy Launch (2006), Sustainable
World Conference (2005), ISP Briefing at the European Parliament (2004) and ISP Launch (2003)

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

### From Supply Chain Research

[[2026-07-17-sce-involution-600x370]][23]

##### [Supply Chain Edge: Evolving involution, forecasting transport prices, sourcing Ukraine’s
##### electronics][24]

July 17, 2026

you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

actionable insights on global trade.

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

#### Search for Importers and Exports

international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

expand their reach.

July 24, 2026

Australian biotechnology company All G has begun US commercial sales of LFX, a precision-fermented
bovine lactoferrin manufactured at under 5% iron saturation. The company describes it as the first
apo-lactoferrin available to manufacturers at commercial scale. The ingredient holds generally
recognized as safe status, with the FDA issuing a “no questions” letter in April 2026 covering its

## [Animal Welfare Labelling Report Puts Method of Production Rules Back on the UK Political
## Agenda][84]

July 24, 2026

FOUR PAWS UK has published research calling for mandatory Method of Production (MoP) labelling on
all animal products sold in the UK, arguing that the current system of voluntary assurance logos and
marketing claims leaves shoppers unable to distinguish between products on welfare grounds. The
report was launched at a Parliamentary event hosted by Alistair Carmichael MP, Chair of the
Environment, Food and Rural Affairs Select Committee, alongside a mock supermarket aisle built to
demonstrate how regulated welfare labels would appear at shelf. Carmichael also wrote the report’s

## About Vaxart

Vaxart is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a range of oral recombinant pill
vaccines based on our innovative delivery platform.

We have proprietary technology, partnerships to accelerate our development, and an experienced team
with deep industry expertise.

## Our Mission

From the beginning, Vaxart has been on a mission to transform global health by pioneering oral pill
vaccines that provide both mucosal and systemic immunity against common viral diseases.

We are dedicated to advancing vaccine science to create safe, effective, and accessible solutions
that protect communities worldwide and empower people to lead healthier lives.

Vaxart’s oral pill vaccines are designed to generate durable mucosal and systemic immunity, offering

## About Vaxart

Vaxart is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a range of oral recombinant pill
vaccines based on our innovative delivery platform.

We have proprietary technology, partnerships to accelerate our development, and an experienced team
with deep industry expertise.

## Our Mission

From the beginning, Vaxart has been on a mission to transform global health by pioneering oral pill
vaccines that provide both mucosal and systemic immunity against common viral diseases.

We are dedicated to advancing vaccine science to create safe, effective, and accessible solutions
that protect communities worldwide and empower people to lead healthier lives.

[Learn About Us][23]

## Our Science

Vaxart’s oral pill vaccines are designed to generate durable mucosal and systemic immunity, offering
a potentially revolutionary advance in immunization technology.

# Home Biose

# Your microbiome partner
# for health and well-being
# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

im Industriebereich, der Spitalhygiene, im Labor- und Pharmasektor sowie in der Hände- und
Flächendesinfektion.

Bei unseren Kunden schaffen wir Mehrwert durch effiziente Reinigungs- und Desinfektionsprozesse und
unterstützen sie damit in ihrer täglichen Arbeit. Die Produkte unserer Marken deconex® und decosept®
stellen wir seit über 60 Jahren an unserem Hauptsitz in der Schweiz her. Mit unseren
Tochtergesellschaften in Deutschland und China sowie unserem Netz an Vertriebspartnern gewährleisten
wir die weltweite Verfügbarkeit unseres breiten Portfolios an erprobten Markenprodukten.

## Entwicklung

Unsere eigene Forschung und Entwicklung ist eine unserer Kernkompetenzen. Mit Blick auf die
Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Märkte und der sich laufend verschärfenden Gesetzgebungen, entwickelt
unser F&E-Team neue Rezepturen. Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren hauseigenen Abteilungen
Qualitätsmanagement und Regulatory Affairs stellt sicher, dass unsere Produkte sowohl den Kunden-
als auch gesetzlichen Anforderungen entsprechen. 

Daneben beschäftigen wir uns laufend und intensiv mit den wichtigsten Aspekten typischer
Reinigungsfragen und der Entwicklung ganzheitlicher Lösungen. Dazu gehören messbare Aussagen zu
rückstandsfreien Oberflächen, die Beurteilung ökologischer Aspekte sowie die Beratung unserer Kunden
und Anwender zum wirtschaftlichsten Einsatz unserer Produkte.

## Familien­unternehmen
## in zweiter Generation

Was 1965 mit einer Vision und der Gründung der «PMC Produkte für Medizin und Chemie» begann, ist
heute ein global agierendes Familienunternehmen. Unser Hauptsitz liegt zwar im ländlichen Zuchwil,
unsere Markenprodukte deconex® und decosept® sind jedoch weltweit erfolgreich im Einsatz. Wir haben
uns in über 50 Jahren ein umfassendes Wissen in den verschiedensten Bereichen der anspruchsvollen
Reinigung und Desinfektion aufgebaut. Als Spezialisten leisten wir in den Branchen, in denen wir
tätig sind, einen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Reinigungs- und Desinfektionsprozesse unserer
Kunden.

Elise Biopharma is a specialized biopharmaceutical CDMO with dual hubs in Cambridge, Massachusetts,
and Montréal, Canada—two of the world’s premier biotech innovation centers. We deliver end-to-end
microbial biomanufacturing services focused on E. coli expression systems, precision fermentation,
and custom bioprocess development. Backed by expert scientists and bioengineers, Elise combines deep
technical expertise with operational agility to provide scalable, high-quality solutions for
biologics, enzymes, proteins, and next-generation therapeutics.

[Elise Biopharma Bioreactor]

As a trusted E. coli CDMO partner, we support clients across the full development lifecycle—from
early R&D and strain engineering to cGMP microbial fermentation, downstream purification, and
analytical testing. Our facilities adhere to the highest standards of regulatory compliance and
quality assurance, making us a reliable manufacturing partner for biotechs developing clinical or
commercial-stage products.

At Elise, our mission is to empower innovation through collaborative, science-first partnerships.
Whether you’re developing recombinant proteins, alternative proteins, or engineered biologics, we
tailor our microbial fermentation services to fit your exact specifications and speed your
time-to-market. With a passion for precision and a commitment to progress, Elise Biopharma is proud
to enable the next wave of biomanufacturing breakthroughs—improving health outcomes and driving
impact across healthcare, diagnostics, and industrial biotechnology.

[Elise Biopharma Biologics rectangle banner]

**Check out our services:**
* [**Microbial CDMO Services** ][99]— High-titer *E. coli* and *Pichia* platforms that take enzymes,
  VLPs, and other recombinant proteins from 5 L feasibility to 2 000 L GMP with endotoxin routinely
  < 0.1 EU mg⁻¹.
* **[Bacteriocins][100]** — End-to-end lantibiotic, colicin, and engineered bacteriocin production,
  from strain design to GMP purification.
* **[mRNA CDMO Services][101]** — Plasmid prep, linear-template IVT, capping, LNP formulation,
  sterile fill-finish, and release assays—all validated for vaccine or gene-editing payloads.
* **[Recombinant Proteins & Enzymes][102]** — Synthetic-biology strain design, AI-guided fed-batch
  control, and multimodal purification for therapeutic proteins and ISO 13485-grade diagnostic
  enzymes.
* **[Fc-Fusion & Bispecifics][103]** — End-to-end design and GMP manufacture of albumin-fusions,
  Fc-extended cytokines, dual-target IgGs, and T-cell–engaging BiTEs.
* [**Antibody Fragments & Nanobodies** ][104]— scFv, Fab, diabody, and single-domain VHH production
  in secretion-tuned microbial hosts with rapid refold and polishing workflows.
* **[Cytokines & Growth Factors][105]** — Engineered cytokines and regenerative growth factors
  expressed at >10 g L⁻¹, refolded and purified for high potency and ultra-low endotoxin.

# Science in Society Archive

The Science in Society website is an archive of scientific reports, journalism and audio visual
material representing two decades of work by the [Institute of Science in Society][7], the
Independent Science Panel, I-SISart and theSparc. There are close to 2000 reports available on this
site: some are previously published in print, others only electronically. The majority are available
for the first time with extra illustrations and references; this site represents a body of work
available nowhere else online or in print. Please search for documents by [category][8], use the
[search function][9], or see a list of all documents in the [sitemap][10]. Hard copies of major
reports are available [here][11], with CD-roms and DVDs available [here][12].

[I-SIS major reports]

### Major Reports

the Institute of Science in Society and the Independent Science Panel produced a number of
significant reports on the topics of Energy policy, Sustainability, Biotechnology, and the
Environment. These are all available in print form and electronically. [Banishing Glyphosate][13] |
[Ban GMOs Now][14] | [Death Camp Fukushima Chernobyl][15] | [The Case for A GM-Free Sustainable
World][16] | [Which Energy?][17] | [Food Futures Now][18] | [Green Energies][19]

[Science in Society Magazine]

### Science in Society Magazine

The influential in-house magazine of the Institute of Science in Society - "The only radical science
magazine on earth". Science in Society (formerly I-SIS News) was published between 1999 and 2016,
and was widely circulated to the public, politicians and policy makers worldwide. Reports from all
69 issues are available on this site - please examine the [SiS index][20] to see the contents of
each issue. Back issues and electronic copies are still available in the SiS online store.

[I-SIS events]

### Events

Aswell as producing scientific reports, the forementioned organisations hosted several high profile
events, including in the British and European Parliaments. These were predominantly scientific, but
also throwing art and music into the mix.

Highlights include the [Colours of Water][21] (2013), [Quantum Jazz - Biology* Medicine* Art][22]
(2011), Green Energies Launch (2009), GM Free Europe (2007), Which Energy Launch (2006), Sustainable
World Conference (2005), ISP Briefing at the European Parliament (2004) and ISP Launch (2003)

[Microbe Notes Cover]

biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established

## 12+ years of successful financing

Watch video

The Micron Global marketing platform (formerly RSW Systems) was founded in 2014 to promote and
finance cutting-edge string transport technologies, as well as other innovative ideas aimed at
improving people’s quality of life.

Our strategy is based on investment crowdfunding. This approach has already enabled a large number
of private investors to become co-owners of the intellectual property behind string transport
technology.

Become part of a technological future and unlock the opportunity to profit from commercial
implementation

String transport technologies help reimagine comfort, safety, environmental friendliness, cost
efficiency, logistics, and the speed of passenger and cargo transportation
For the first time in the transport industry, key innovations have become possible thanks to the
efficiency of crowdfunding

### Available investments

Becoming a co-owner of innovative technologies is easy! The minimum investment is only $100 —
opening opportunities for anyone who wants to benefit

[/_next/static/media/1.7cad341e.jpg]

### Steady risk minimization

The company successfully transitioned from startup to business stage, winning the attention of
investors, governments and business community. The asset value is growing rapidly every day

[/_next/static/media/2.8e6d0cfb.jpg]

### Solving global challenges
* environmentally friendly transport
* reducing fatal traffic accidents
* solving traffic congestion
* lowering implementation and operating costs
* minimal land use
* reduced noise levels
* speeds of up to 500 km/h

[/_next/static/media/3.6f769585.jpg]

structured career model, ranks, and statuses—all based on transparency, security, and global
support. Every element of the system is designed to deliver results, from personal growth to
business scaling and strengthening your investment portfolio.Micron Global is a structure people
trust. Tools that work. Approaches that deliver results.

With more than a decade of experience behind us, we know how to help partners achieve their goals.

The project team and your personal mentor will help you understand all the subtle details and solve

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]
